lines.zh: 我踩着沼泽的软泥前进。
lines.en: I tread the marsh's soft mud.
Foul water laps my insteps.
Reeds part beside me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖出一道泥痕。
lines.en: My tail drags a muddy line.
Bubbles rise from the muck.
Mist skims the water behind me.
I wade step by step into the shallows.
The insects stop because I came.
Wet hair clings to my shoulders.
In water I walk as on flat ground.
I skirt the rotting tree roots.
Moonlight shatters on the murky water.
My song drops to a breath.
The silt grips me and lets go.
I walk toward the lantern light.
The shore grass pricks more than water.
I comb my hair slowly in the muck.
The water shows my face.
My song thickens the swamp mist.
A frog hops onto the driftwood.
The swamp's smell is familiar.
I count the ripples on the water.
Poison is only spice to me.
I wait for the mist to thicken.
In water my wounds close.
Something hides in the reeds.
I shake my soaked sleeve.
A night bird calls from a dead branch.
My throat tickles a little.
Being still feels good.
Did you hear my song?
Come closer, don't be afraid.
Your boots are soaked through.
You smell of dry earth.
I know that lost look.
Look at me, don't turn away.
The muddy water mirrors half my face.
Why are your hands shaking?
When I sing, you cannot walk away.
Stay there, don't come closer.
The muck reddens with my blood.
You cut my song short.
My voice cracked for a moment.
The marsh will remember for me.
Don't touch my face.
Pain jerks my tail.
Mud's in my hair now.
I can still sing through this.
You hit harder than you look.
I retreat into the water.
For me? How kind.
Nothing in the mud smells like this.
A little more, I'm not satisfied.
Hold it out, don't toss it.
This scent reminds me of the shore.
You'd really part with it?
I see you hid one more.
Nearer, I can't tell.
Nothing in the water is fresh.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我可不是在讨好你。
lines.en: Why smile? I'm not flattering you.

lines.zh: 你把泥水溅到了我裙上。
lines.en: You splashed mud on my skirt.
Don't brush my wet body.
Back off, the reeds will snap.
That knock left my ears ringing.
You stepped on my tail.
The marsh path fits only one.
Keep your hands off my hair.
Mud splashed into my mouth.
Bump me again and I sing.
My wet hair brushes your wrist.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的歌声没有情意。
lines.en: Songs in the marsh carry no affection.
My song is only bait.
You likely won't see morning.
Don't mistake enchantment for love.
I prefer the quiet underwater.
Only those of the water do such things.
Your breath is too shallow.
I did not come for a partner.
The tide will wash such thoughts away.
When the song ends, we part.

lines.zh: 水里的东西捞起来就是我的。
lines.en: What I fish from the water is mine.
A cod, still alive.
Muddy iron nuggets, still usable.
This quiver is sealed tight.
I bend, mud covers my hands.
Dropped in the shallows, so it's mine.
The box's corners have rusted.

lines.zh: 我把东西掖进腰间的布袋。
lines.en: I tuck it into my belt pouch.
This shell can be blown for a note.
You dropped it, I won't return it.
A song rises from the reeds.
At this range I can start my song.
Don't rush off, hear me out.
Your legs will grow heavier.
I've found you, traveler.
Mist is rising off the water.
Hear the reeds harmonize with me.
Stand there and don't move.
Swamp water carries my voice.
You won't escape this mire.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸跟着我的拍子。
lines.en: Your breath keeps my rhythm.
One more step and you sink.

lines.zh: 我的歌声钻进你的骨头。
lines.en: My song seeps into your bones.
You can't lift your arms now.
The mud below will grip your feet.
Still counting the beats?

lines.zh: 我唱得越高，你走得越慢。
lines.en: The higher I sing, the slower you move.
Don't look back, I'm right there.
Your ears have gone red.
Three lines more and you are mine.
My claws rake your chest.
You're dragged into the shallows.
This slap comes with mud.
Don't cover it, blood drains into the water.
My tail sweeps your knees.
Scream if it hurts, it sounds sweeter.
Your weapon sinks into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下带着沼泽的臭气。
lines.en: This blow carries the swamp's stink.
Close range, no song needed.
Your movements have slowed.

lines.zh: 沼泽深处传来一声长吟。
lines.en: A long note rises from the deep marsh.
The water parts, I surface.
The reeds stir without wind.
Someone has entered my mire.
The mist rises first; then I sing.

lines.zh: 夜里的第一声蛙鸣停了。
lines.en: The night's first frog croak stops.
I step from behind the rotting log.
A face appears in the murky water.
The marsh won't be quiet tonight.
I open my mouth, first a sigh.
Fire steams my wet hair.
I drop from the dead tree into mud.
Silt pours down my throat.
The blast throws up water and flips me.
An arrowhead sticks in my shoulder.
Spell-light blinds me.
Hunger steals my high notes.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，顺着泥爬上来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and crawls up the mud.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，也没有声音。
lines.en: No water, no sound, only void.
